profile.headline: Sr. Software Developer | C#, .Net, Azure, SQL | Microsoft Azure Certified
profile.summary:
•Worked on C#, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, Model-View-Controller (MVC), SQL Server, Data Integration, Javascript, Telerik Kendo UI , Atlassian (JIRA), Tortoise SVN, REST API & Web Services, Postman,  AJAX, Bootstrap, etc.
•Developed Customer Relationship Management Websites, daily offshore client interaction, active team member of the team of coordinator, manager, tester, front & back end developers.
•Successfully handled a Craft YouTube channel “Bluestorm Diy & Crafts” having more than 4.2 million channel views and more than 24,000 subscribers.
•Opportunity to work on Adobe Photoshop CS6, Wondershare Filmora Video Editor, video shooting.
•Entrepreneurship by selling cards through online orders.

positions.title: Senior Backend Developer
positions.description:
Designed and built REST APIs, Azure Serverless functions, back-end services on Azure using C#.
Design & Develop .Net Applications for the internal tech and non-tech teams to automate the manual process.
Onboard junior developers on existing projects and provide support on their tasks.
Successfully led Snap-shot Regression App leveraging Headless chrome to increase time efficiency in QA.
Developed and Integrated Email preview feature using Azure service bus, Azure Function and Salesforce Marketing cloud
to the client’s tool to validate emails before sent to their customers.
Successfully created Data extraction tool for SMC XML files using Python, Beautiful soup library and SQL Server.
Coded a server-side JavaScript script on NodeJS to integrate as AMPScript on SMC cloud for the log comparison.

projects.title: Pet Adoption Decentralized application
projects.description:
Technologies: Truffle, Ganache, Node.js, Bootstrap, Metamask plugin, Web3js

Successfully completed the Pet adoption Dapp application as a final project for the course CSE 5347 Blockchain. Allows the user to adopt a pet from the list and successfully complete the transaction using the Metamask and Etherium coins.

projects.title: Game Rating Predictor
projects.description:
Technologies used: Python, Flask, NumPy, Pandas, Pickle, Sklearn, Heroku

Created a successful and running python application made on flask to predict the video game rating based on the user comments and well-deployed using Heroku and Git LFS. Achieved the best precision with the help of NLP procedure: data chunking, data cleaning, and exploration, Count Vectorization, TF-IDF, model comparison, improved the model by Smoothing, K-fold, Polynomial regression, Hyperparameter tuning, Confusion Matrix
